messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary monitor 'eu-hosted-gen-req' firing 5/5 probes failed in 2m window. Severity: P3
maria-ops: seeing a spike in canary failures, not seeing related 5xx in prod logs yet, suspect probe sensitivity
kevin-sre: I can triage — starting with last 10m of probe traces. @maria-ops do we have the probe payload? link: https://s3.redwood/probes/eu-hosted-gen-req/1842003205
maria-ops: payload is small, simple prompt. I'll paste below.
maria-ops: ```
{
 "prompt": "translate: hello",
 "model": "open-compat-13b",
 "top_k": 40
}
```
kevin-sre: ok looking at probe logs — high tail latency on one instance (gpu-23) followed by 504s from the proxy. Not global.
ashok-pm: any customer impact reported? support?
kate-support: no tickets yet but we got one chat complaining about slow generation for a specific region 10m ago. Marked as investigating.
sre-lead: recommend muting automated page for this specific canary while we investigate — it's noisy. Can we run a temporary suppression for 30m?
kevin-sre: I'm going to mute canary via infra tool: `infractl monitors mute --id eu-hosted-gen-req --reason "investigating transient tail latency" --expires 30m`
oncall-bot: infractl action accepted — eu-hosted-gen-req muted until +30m (muted by kevin-sre)
maria-ops: while muted, I'm spinning up a targeted smoke against that instance set and will repro.
kevin-sre: repro shows cold-start/warm-up pattern — heavy GPU memory pressure during concurrent cache fill. I see KV cache misses and a spike in GC on the runtime process.
maria-ops: so false positives because the canary threshold is too tight for one bad host. Current config is 5 failures in 2m.
sre-lead: proposed mitigation: 1) lower probe frequency to 30s -> 60s for EU region for next 24h 2) change threshold to 3 failures in 5m 3) add a sliding window that ignores single-host correlated failures
ashok-pm: please also create a dashboard tile showing per-instance failure distribution — product wants to see customer impact mapping
kevin-sre: creating PR with changes to monitor config + new grafana panel. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/monitors/merge_requests/1423
kevin-sre: config diff snippet:
```
frequency: 60s -> was 30s
failure_threshold: 3/5m -> was 5/2m
aggregation: multi-host-aware (ignore if failures concentrated on <=25% hosts)
```
maria-ops: deploying PR to canary config in staging now, will watch.
oncall-bot: deploy job started: monitors-service/patch-config #1423
oncall-bot: deploy job succeeded: monitors-service/patch-config #1423
kevin-sre: new config active. Re-enabled monitor with updated thresholds.
oncall-bot: monitor eu-hosted-gen-req resumed.
kevin-sre: keeping suppression window of 15m after resume to avoid immediate noise, then auto-unmute.
kate-support: I'll queue a customer-impact note for the incident timeline: "short lived probe failures affecting EU region; isolated to single instance set; customers may have seen transient latency around 1842003200 UTC; no widespread 5xx observed." 
ashok-pm: nice. follow-ups: longer term we should add exponential backoff for probe retries, and a canary-run historical baseline to auto-adjust thresholds.
sre-lead: agreed — created follow-up ticket: https://projects.redwood/ISSUE-987 (add adaptive canary thresholds + per-instance metrics)
maria-ops: retro item: clarify operator playbook for muting vs paging. I'll add to runbook.
kevin-sre: final check — dashboards show per-host errors returned to normal. I'll close the pager and mark P3 mitigated.
oncall-bot: Pager closed by kevin-sre — reason: config tuned + host recovered. Duration: 22m
maria-ops: thanks all. small action list: 1) staff follow-up on ISSUE-987, 2) update runbook, 3) monitor for 24h. :thumbsup:
ashok-pm: thanks. good run — clear notes for customer comms if anything emerges.
